# Wondershare PDFelement

> Wondershare PDFelement is an AI-powered PDF solution offering desktop, mobile, cloud, and online tools for creating, editing, converting, and managing documents.

PDFelement provides comprehensive PDF tools across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms, complemented by free online utilities and enterprise solutions. The platform integrates advanced AI capabilities including OCR recognition, document summarization, and intelligent PDF chat features.

## Key Topics

- PDFelement
- AI-powered PDF editing
- PDF conversion
- Document management
- OCR recognition
- PDF annotation
- E-signature
- Cloud collaboration
- Mobile PDF tools
- Online PDF tools
- PDF merge and compress
- Document Cloud
- PDF reader
- Batch conversion
- SDK integration

## Core Products & Platforms

- [Wondershare PDFelement - Main Product](https://pdf.wondershare.com): Wondershare PDFelement homepage with AI-powered PDF creation, editing, and conversion tools.
- [PDFelement for Mac](https://pdf.wondershare.com/pdfelement-mac.html): PDFelement for macOS with AI-powered PDF editing and OCR recognition.
- [PDFelement for iOS](https://pdf.wondershare.com/pdf-editor-app.html): AI-powered PDFelement app for iOS with PDF editing, signing, and chatting.
- [PDFelement for Android](https://pdf.wondershare.com/pdfelement-android): AI-powered PDFelement for Android with PDF editing, OCR, and annotation.
- [PDFelement for Business](https://pdf.wondershare.com/business): PDFelement enterprise solution for business PDF editing and document management.

## Cloud & Collaboration

- [Wondershare Document Cloud](https://pdf.wondershare.com/document-cloud): Wondershare Document Cloud collaboration and cloud storage solution for PDFs.

## Online PDF Tools

- [All-in-One Online PDF Tools Suite](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf.html): Suite of free online PDF tools including merge, convert, edit, and compress.
- [PDF to Word Converter](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf/pdf-to-word.html): Free online PDF to Word converter with OCR and batch conversion support.
- [Word to PDF Converter](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf/word-to-pdf.html): Free online Word to PDF converter with batch conversion capability.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf/compress-pdf.html): Free online PDF compression tool to reduce file size without quality loss.
- [Merge PDF](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf/merge-pdf.html): Free online tool to merge and combine multiple PDF files into one.
- [AI PDF Reader](https://pdf.wondershare.com/online-pdf/ai-pdf-reader.html): Free AI-powered PDF reader for summarization, explanation, and PDF chat.

## PDF Readers & Viewers

- [Wondershare PDF Reader](https://pdf.wondershare.com/pdf-reader.html): Free Wondershare PDF Reader for viewing, annotating, and signing PDFs.
- [Free PDF Reader](https://pdf.wondershare.com/read-pdf-files.html): AI-powered free PDF reader with text-to-speech and bookmark features.

## PDF Editing & Annotation Guides

- [Annotate & Highlight PDF](https://pdf.wondershare.com/annotate-pdf.html): Guide to PDF annotation and highlighting with PDFelement tools.
- [Create PDF Files](https://pdf.wondershare.com/create-pdf-files.html): Guide to creating PDFs from various file formats using PDFelement.
- [Combine & Merge PDFs](https://pdf.wondershare.com/combine-pdf.html): Guide to combining and merging multiple PDFs with PDFelement.
- [Convert PDF Files](https://pdf.wondershare.com/convert-pdf.html): Guide to converting PDFs to Word, Excel, images, and other formats.
- [Print PDF Files](https://pdf.wondershare.com/print-pdf-files.html): Guide to printing PDFs with PDFelement across multiple platforms.

## Developer Resources

- [PDFelement SDK](https://pdf.wondershare.com/pdfelement-sdk.html): PDFelement SDK for developers to embed PDF processing features.
